title: Profile approval expiry (default 24h, --ttl)
description: DEC-217 / ODOC-488 step 2a: approvals carry an expiry field, default 24h, explicit --ttl at approval; admission checks expiry inside the transaction. Changes the vault format, so lands before any freeze.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ward profile approve accepts --ttl and defaults to 24h
Admission after expiry is refused with a fixed code, makes no network attempt and writes no admission audit record
Expiry is checked inside the admission transaction
docs/security-tests.md or its test list names the expiry tests
